_comment: Slag Rubble: the Nether's Stone Rubble, and it does the same job (owner, 2026-08-19).
Sift a shard out, put four together, get the terrain block back - the exact shape
rubble_pulls and stone_from_shards already use in the demolition yard.
This is the ONLY source of Nether terrain in the game: the compacted depths generate no
netherrack, no basalt and no soul sand, so every block of it is rebuilt from shards. That is
what makes the dimension worth mining rather than a place you pass through.
Weights mirror rubble_pulls' shape - the common ground leads, the specials trail. Final
numbers belong to the balance pass (#36).
